title: Battle of Angol
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Angol", at revision 1370106826, opens: "The Battle of Angol was fought between the Mapuche and the Spanish Empire on 25 March 1564 as part of Arauco War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3636323, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1564 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
